messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Meridian renewal. Procurement wants to change billing entity to Meridian EU Ltd and add a VAT clause. Onboarding shows 2 remaining enablement workshops and they haven't scheduled them. Need a quick path to sign + PO so we don't delay their go-live.
liam_ae: Do we have account health + link? any red flags besides the workshops?
maria_cs: Account health: green for usage and QBR ok. Link: https://redwood.internal/accounts/meridian/health. Main blocker is procurement asked vendor code swap and an EU VAT clause.
raj_ops: Procurement note: vendor code in PO (99871) doesn't match our finance record (56782). Finance won't code until tax ID + legal entity match. If they supply delegated signer email we can accept a signed PO from that entity, but need legal confirmation on authority.
sophie_legal: We need evidence of delegation for Meridian EU Ltd. Ask them to attach either: a signed resolution or a certificate of incumbency. For VAT we need the reverse-charge language for EU customers — I can drop the exact wording.
kelly_fin: Confirming finance can remap vendor code if we get: legal entity name, registered tax ID (VAT number), and PO number. Net30 is fine. If they want CC we can do that too.
maria_cs: I'll request tax ID + delegated signer today. Also asking if they can e-sign via DocuSign. Can someone paste the VAT clause text?
sophie_legal: Sure — use this snippet in the SOW: `Customer shall be responsible for any VAT or similar taxes under the reverse charge mechanism where applicable.` I'll add it to SOW v3.
liam_ae: Quick question — can we offer onboarding credit to move workshops up? Product said we can provide up to 8 hours of dedicated enablement credit for renewals.
raj_ops: Operationally, note that Dedicated capacity provisioning needs signed PO + 7 business days. If they want <7 days, they can start on hosted with higher rate limits temporarily.
maria_cs: OK — offering 6 hours of enablement credit to Meridian to accelerate. I'll ask procurement if they can provide the tax ID + delegated signer by EOD. Pinging procurement contact externally now. :phone: @MeridianProcurement
maria_cs: Posting required PO fields for them so it's clear:
```
company_name: Meridian EU Ltd
tax_id: VAT-XXXXXXX
signer_name: Full Name
signer_email: name@meridian.example
vendor_code: 99871 (or state existing)
po_number: PO-####
```
kelly_fin: That list is perfect. Once we have those we can map vendor code and approve booking.
sophie_legal: I'll standby for the delegation doc. If they can't provide incumbency, we can accept a signed attestation on company letterhead + signer's ID, but escalation to legal ops may be slower.
liam_ae: Thx team. If they sign and provide docs today we can target billing start next Monday.
deploy-bot: SOW v3 uploaded: /legal/sows/meridian-sow-v3.pdf (uploaded by sophie_legal)
maria_cs: Great — I'll update the renewal sheet and loop in the customer. Will post updates here once they respond. :+1:
